items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio walkthrough of Jews arriving with the Normans, blood libels, royal exploitation and Edward I's expulsion of 1290.

items.title: Jews in Medieval England (1070-1290)
items.description: Detailed history of the Jewish community in Norman and Plantagenet England — from arrival to expulsion. 12 min.

items.title: Why King Edward I Expelled the Jews from England in 1290
items.description: The motivations behind the Edict of Expulsion — debt, religious pressure and royal politics. 8 min.

items.title: Antisemitism in the Medieval Period | Hunting for History | BBC Teach
items.description: BBC Teach resource on medieval antisemitism — blood libels and pogroms in context. 6 min.

items.title: The Pianist (2002)
items.description: Much later in time, but shows where centuries of antisemitism — rooted in the medieval period — ultimately led.

items.title: National Archives — Education Resources
items.description: The National Archives holds medieval records on Jewish communities in England — primary source education packs.

items.description: Official OCR J411 spec — check the assessment criteria for the Migration to Britain depth study.
